Behavior: If start falls on weekend, first move forward to following Monday. Then move forward n business days. So n==0 returns start itself on a weekday and the following Monday on a weekend. And Friday plus one business day is the next Monday.

Implementation:

```
if n == 0:
    return start
day = start
if day.weekday() >= 5:
    day += timedelta(days=7 - day.weekday())
weeks, extra = divmod(n, 5)
day += timedelta(weeks=weeks)
if day.weekday() + extra >= 5:
    extra += 2
return day + timedelta(days=extra)
```
